trigger_condition: getText() returns empty/undefined (e.g. sessionId unset) when Copy button clicked
potential_consequence: Click produces zero feedback; user can't tell the copy silently did nothing

trigger_condition: s.sessionId is falsy/empty but the ID row and its Copy button still render unconditionally
potential_consequence: Non-functional copy button shown with no visual difference from a working one, unlike the file row's own guard

trigger_condition: s.agentSessionFile is a very long absolute path
potential_consequence: Long path overflows/breaks the modal row layout, unlike branch/title fields which already truncate with ellipsis+title

trigger_condition: cost enrichment resolves/uses a log path independently of raw.agentSessionFile (see cost-enricher.ts loadAgentSessionFile fallback), so hadLog/pricing can succeed while s.agentSessionFile is still absent
guard_snippet: show 'File: Not available' only when !s.agentSessionFile && !s.hadLog; otherwise note the discrepancy
potential_consequence: Modal displays 'File: Not available' while the same modal's cost/coverage stats show the session was priced from a log
